Agility Robotics.label: Agility Robotics
Agility Robotics.basis: Legacy Agility historical columns in the November 6 closing exhibit; H1 unaudited, FY2025 derived from audited historical statements. The combined pro forma results are not used.
Agility Robotics.detail: FY2025 sales were USD 1.782M, including USD 1.132M from related parties (63.5%, calculated). Closing occurred November 4; the November 6 filing identifies AGLT on Nasdaq.
Agility Robotics.takeaway: Author interpretation: early recognized revenue and related-party concentration call for separate evidence of repeatable third-party demand. Orders and factory capacity do not resolve that test.

Unitree.label: Unitree
Unitree.period: Q3 and nine months to Sep 30, 2026
Unitree.basis: Unaudited issuer Q3 report, pp. 1–4 and 9. RMB retained; group results include multiple robot product lines.
Unitree.detail: Nine-month revenue: RMB 1,817.3M. Gross margin: 54.0%, calculated as (1,817.290 − 835.566) ÷ 1,817.290. Q3 R&D intensity: 19.10%. Nine-month profit excluding non-recurring items fell 18.78%.
Unitree.takeaway: Author interpretation: revenue scale is visible, but quarterly profit and cash conversion still need scrutiny. Group sales do not establish autonomous industrial productivity.

sources.label: Q3 report: actuals and cash flow

AgiBot.label: AgiBot
AgiBot.basis: Revenue is a company statement reported by Pacific Technology on October 29, not an audited filing. The production milestone appears in the company’s October 30 release.
AgiBot.detail: No audited margin or cash-flow figure is established here. Production is not shipments, customer acceptance or paid autonomous operating hours. Shipment estimates from research firms use differing definitions and are not substituted for company sales.
AgiBot.takeaway: Author interpretation: use as a directional scale indicator, with lower comparability than exchange-filed financial statements. Do not treat IPO ambitions as a completed listing.

UBTech.label: UBTECH
UBTech.basis: Unaudited interim results. Group financials and full-size humanoid products/services are different scopes.
UBTech.detail: Full-size humanoid products and services: RMB 590.3M revenue and 921 units sold. This category spans industrial, commercial, education/research and consumer applications; it is not solely factory labor replacement.
UBTech.takeaway: Author interpretation: positive gross margin can coexist with a group net loss. Test the mix and support costs behind scale, rather than treating every humanoid sale as an industrial deployment.

Dobot.label: Dobot
Dobot.basis: Unaudited interim results; group scope covers cobots and other robot products.
Dobot.detail: Embodied AI robot revenue was RMB 45.2M, or 14.3% of group revenue. The category includes multiple forms; group sales should not be relabeled humanoid revenue.
Dobot.takeaway: Author interpretation: compare the emerging embodied AI business with the established cobot base. Gross margin alone does not cover R&D and other operating costs.

FANUC.label: FANUC
FANUC.basis: Issuer interim results, not subject to audit. Fiscal half-year ends September 30; not calendar H1.
FANUC.detail: Group sales: JPY 473.7B. Service covers machine tools and robots; the group operating margin is not a separately disclosed ROBOT division margin.
FANUC.takeaway: Author interpretation: an established automation supplier provides a commercialization benchmark, not a direct humanoid peer or a universal margin target.

GrayMatter Robotics.label: GrayMatter Robotics
GrayMatter Robotics.basis: HII customer announcement; a performance-based opportunity shared with Path Robotics.
GrayMatter Robotics.detail: HII intends to award work contingent on technology, manufacturing-readiness and performance milestones. The ceiling is not guaranteed backlog, booked revenue or GrayMatter’s individual contract value.
GrayMatter Robotics.takeaway: Author interpretation: customer-backed commercial potential is useful evidence, but realized revenue, margin and cash collection remain separate tests.
